svg.title: Fields and level sets
svg.desc: A wind of vortices, a source and a sink: arrows, then evenly spaced streamlines drawing on and particles flowing along them. Beside it, a heart growing as the level set of an implicit function, and a slope field with three solution curves.
svg.text: (x² + y² − 1)³ − x²y³ = c, c rising to 0
